faq.q: How does the AI image background changer work?
faq.a: It finds the product in your photo and separates it from the room behind it, so you can remove that room or replace it.

faq.q: Where do I get backgrounds for a product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a ready setting, upload a backdrop of your own, or choose a solid color. The cost shows before the photo is made.

faq.q: What should I look for in a background changer?
faq.a: Look for simple controls, clean edges, and a result you can post. This tool is built for product photos.

faq.q: How do I add a background to a photo online?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your image, describe the setting you want, and download a studio-style product photo.

faq.q: How do I replace a product background online?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the product photo. The tool finds the product, then you can place white, a studio set, or another backdrop behind it.
The product should keep its angle, color, and shape. Compare the result with the photo you uploaded before you list it.

faq.q: Can I use the new photo in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark. You can use it for your business. Add any price or offer in your ad editor after you download.

faq.q: Can I run several backgrounds from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a studio surface, a wood tone, and an outdoor table from the same photo. Each photo is 24 credits, shown before you start.

faq.q: Can the new photo become a video?
faq.a: Yes. Open a moving clip from the same photo, or start from a product link. Add a script, a spoken voice, captions, and music, then publish.
One photo is 24 credits, shown before you start. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A failed job returns those credits.
